vulnerability.name: USN-4857-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that Burrows-Wheeler Aligner (BWA) mishandled certain crafted .alt files. An attacker could use this vulnerability to cause a denial of service (crash) or possibly execute arbitrary code.

statements.status_notes: BWA could be made to crash or run programs as an administrator if it opened a specially crafted file. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
